subject: Post-demo: buying path, stakeholders & security evidence deliverables
messages:
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Johnson <claire@celeritashealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + ask: stakeholders & security evidence needed

Claire — thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so your procurement and security teams have everything in one place.

Highlights from call:
- Goal: prototype an inference-backed triage assistant for prior authorization workflows (POC scope: 3k monthly active cases, 512 token average).
- Decision criteria you noted: accuracy on extracted fields (>95%), latency <300ms p50, and clear auditability for PHI-handling paths.
- Timeline: security review ~2 weeks, procurement SOW/PO in ~3–4 weeks, pilot kickoff target early July.

Information we need to help your teams move faster (can you confirm who owns each item?):
1) Economic buyer: is Alice Martin (CFO) the final sign-off? please confirm contact and any finance constraints.
2) Security lead: David Li — can we get his preferred contact method/time for a short 30-minute session?
3) Procurement contact and PO terms (net30, exceptions, required insurance limits).
4) Required security evidence: SOC 2 Type II report, recent pen test summary, retention rules for audit logs, and any additional compliance questionnaires.

What we’re attaching and what we can provide immediately:
- Attached: redwood-soc2-type2-summary.pdf (executive summary + scope) — high level redacted attestation.
- Can provide: pen-test summary (we have a non-sensitive summary we can share next business day), sample audit log schema and retention practices (CSV sample attached upon request).
- Proposed artifact: a one-page MoP (model operating plan) for the pilot outlining data flows, minimization, and logging. Draft ready; will share with Marissa in the loop.

Proposed next steps:
- Claire: confirm the list of stakeholders and the procurement email.
- David: 30-min security sync (Ben will join to answer runtime/architecture questions).
- If possible: share any procurement templates (SOW/PO/contract redlines) so we can surface them to legal.

I’ll coordinate attachments and a concise package for David and procurement once you confirm stakeholders.

Thanks — ikr, looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: redwood-soc2-type2-summary.pdf (executive summary, redacted)
From: Claire Johnson <claire@celeritashealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Li <david.li@celeritashealth.com>, procurement@celeritashealth.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + ask: stakeholders & security evidence needed

Karthik — appreciate the concise recap. A few answers from our side:

Stakeholders and contacts:
- Economic buyer: Alice Martin <alice.martin@celeritashealth.com> (CFO) — she’ll want a short 15–20 min business case overview.
- Security lead: David Li <david.li@celeritashealth.com> — please include Ben for technical/runtime items. David prefers mornings (10–11am ET).
- Procurement: procurement@celeritashealth.com (I copied them). PO terms: typically net45; exceptions require Finance approval.

Security evidence asks (David flagged these during our internal huddle):
- Full SOC 2 Type II report (redacted if needed) + attestation.
- High-level pen test summary that avoids vendor-sensitive exploit details (OK to redact specifics).
- Confirmation of audit log fields (what’s captured: request id, user id, model version, timestamps, prompt/response retention policy) and retention window options.
- Data residency: we must confirm US-only processing and encryption-at-rest + in-transit.
- Data deletion and minimum retention policy for PHI-bearing objects — we need a statement of capabilities.

Timing: Security review starts week of Jun 15; procurement will start their legal template review the week after. If you can get the SOC2 + pen test summary and a one-page MoP into David before Monday 15th, that will help (we’ll schedule the security sync Tues or Wed).

Also — we’ll need a simple pricing summary for a 3-month POC (reserved capacity estimate + expected tokens). Procurement will ask for an SOW and a sample PO flow.

I’ll loop Alice in once we have the security artifacts and pricing.

Thanks,
Claire
Senior PM, Digital Transformation
Celeritas Health

On Wed, Jun 10, 2026 at 2:08 PM karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Claire — thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so your procurement and security teams have everything in one place.
> 
> [initial recap omitted]

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Johnson <claire@celeritashealth.com>, David Li <david.li@celeritashealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + ask: stakeholders & security evidence needed — pen test + logs

Claire / David — Ben on the SE side. Quick answers and attachments to keep the review moving.

Answers to David’s bullets:
- SOC 2: attached is the redwood-soc2-type2-summary.pdf. We can provide the full report under NDA; redacted public summary attached.
- Pen test: attached is pen-test-2025-summary.txt — high-level scope and remediation status. Sensitive exploit write-ups are omitted.
- Audit logs: sample schema included (audit-logs-sample.csv). We capture request_id, timestamp_utc, model_version, route, truncated_prompt_hash, response_id, latency_ms, and user_id. We can configure retention per customer policy (30/90/365 days or custom).
- Data residency: Redwood hosted options include US-only regions — we will confirm region and include the data residency clause in the MoP.
- Deletion: we support on-demand deletion for user-provided corpora and configurable retention for request/response logs; default is 90 days for POC unless your legal needs longer.

Attachments included: pen-test-2025-summary.txt, audit-logs-sample.csv.

Next steps I propose:
1) Share a 1‑pager MoP for the pilot (Marissa/Ben to produce) — will include architecture diagram, data flows, and the exact log fields.
2) Schedule 30-min security sync Tues 16 Jun 10:30am ET — David, does that work?
3) Karhik to produce a concise pricing SOW for a 3-month pilot and draft PO language for procurement.

If David wants any additional logs or a short architecture walkthrough with infra screenshots we can provide that in a follow-up.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: pen-test-2025-summary.txt; audit-logs-sample.csv
From: David Li <david.li@celeritashealth.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Johnson <claire@celeritashealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:32:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + ask: stakeholders & security evidence needed — pen test + logs

Ben / Team — thanks for the artifacts. Quick notes after a pass through the materials: 

- SOC 2 summary: looks fine as a starting point; need the full report under NDA if possible. Please share ATO/controls mapping to any specific gaps we might have for PHI.
- Pen test summary: acceptable. Can you add a short appendix describing the scope (external vs internal vs app-layer) and remediation SLAs (e.g., 30/60/90 days)?
- Audit logs: the sample schema is helpful — can you confirm whether truncated_prompt_hash is reversible under any condition and how we handle full prompt storage for any debugging? We need guaranteed non-reversible hashing for PHI fields.
- Retention: default 90 days ok for POC; for production we’ll likely request 365 with the option to archive to customer-managed S3. Need to see the export path and encryption controls.

I’m available for the 30-min sync today at 10:30am ET. Please send calendar invite.

-David Li
Head of Security Engineering
Celeritas Health
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Johnson <claire@celeritashealth.com>, David Li <david.li@celeritashealth.com>, procurement@celeritashealth.com
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + ask: stakeholders & security evidence needed — next steps + SOW

Thanks everyone — quick logistic note and concrete next steps from Redwood’s side.

What we’ll deliver by end of day Monday 15th (as requested):
- Full SOC 2 report under NDA (we will send a secure link and NDA template).
- Pen test appendix: scope and remediation timelines (Ben will add the SLAs).
- One-page MoP and a draft SOW/pricing for a 3-month pilot (Marissa + I will produce this).
- Clarify logging guarantees: we will provide non-reversible hashing for prompt truncation, export path to customer-managed S3 with server-side encryption, and configurable retention policies (30/90/365 plus archive).

Action items & owners:
- Ben: finalize pen test appendix + confirm reversible vs non-reversible hashing details (due EOD Fri).
- Marissa: MoP + SOW draft (due Mon EOD) and draft sample PO language for procurement.
- Stephanie (legal ops): standby to review procurement template and flag any required exceptions.
- Karthik: coordinate NDA and SOC2 full-report delivery, and confirm pricing draft.

Claire / Procurement: if you can send any specific PO language or insurance requirements that speed review, we’ll incorporate them into the SOW.

I’ll follow up with the secure link for the SOC 2 once the NDA is in place. Thanks — we’ll keep the sync tight so your timeline holds.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: poc-mop-draft.docx (draft)
